title: Where is the lift in the picture?
description: The picture of the tall block shows many parts, and only one tall strip carries a pair of buttons, one for up and one for down. The pair of buttons is used to pick out the lift. A lift in a mineshaft shows the same up and down idea in real life.
teaching_notes: One idea: the lift is known by its two buttons, one that goes up and one that goes down. Watch for students who pick the biggest part of the picture instead of looking for the buttons.

source: A lift is used to go up and down between the floors. It has
video_script.why: A child learns what the lift looks like in the picture, because every later question moves the lift with its two buttons.
video_script.substitution: the lift and its two buttons in the book's own picture of the tall block
video_script.anchor: Ruhee: the tall block of shops with the lift on its right side and a pair of buttons beside it
video_script.payoff_line: The lift is the tall strip with the two buttons.

final_answer.value: The lift is the tall strip with the two buttons, at the right side of the picture.
final_answer.spoken: the tall strip with the two buttons at the right side of the picture

names.Ruhee: the multi-storey block of floors above and below the ground, used as the model for integers

hold_back: Answer: the lift is the tall strip with the two buttons, at the right side
maths_rules: The lift has two buttons: the plus button goes up and the minus button goes down.
In the book's picture the lift is the vertical strip with buttons at the right side of the block.
video_script.design: One idea: the pair of buttons gives the lift away. One picture throughout; the buttons are the only thing that lights up. Real life: a lift in a mineshaft, from the book's own mine picture.
